name: Instructed Corporate Action Option 23
definition: Provides corporate action option details about total instructed balance.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

DefaultAction.name: Default Action
DefaultAction.definition: Indicates the default action related to a corporate action event.

OptionAcceptedInstructedBalance.name: Option Accepted Instructed Balance
OptionAcceptedInstructedBalance.definition: Daily total of accepted instructions received for a given option.

OptionCancelledInstructionBalance.name: Option Cancelled Instruction Balance
OptionCancelledInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of cancelled instructions for a given option.

OptionPendingInstructionBalance.name: Option Pending Instruction Balance
OptionPendingInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of pending instructions in pending status for a given option.  It includes cancel pending instructions.

OptionRejectedInstructionBalance.name: Option Rejected Instruction Balance
OptionRejectedInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of rejected instructions for a given option.

OptionReturnedInstructedBalance.name: Option Returned Instructed Balance
OptionReturnedInstructedBalance.definition: Daily total of returned instructions received for a given option.

OptionProtectInstructionBalance.name: Option Protect Instruction Balance
OptionProtectInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of all protect instructions for a given option.

EventDeadlines.name: Event Deadlines
EventDeadlines.definition: Provides information about the deadlines related to a corporate action option.

OptionInstructionDetails.name: Option Instruction Details
OptionInstructionDetails.definition: Instructions details received for the given option.
